# Functions
```{r functions, include = FALSE}
## --- convert power in uV^2 to dB ---
uV2_to_dB <- function(uV2){
  dB <- 10*log10(uV2)
}

## --- outlier detection of lmer models ---
outlier_modelresiduals <- function(df, model_residuals, var2clean){
  # z-score residuals
  residuals_z <- scale(model_residuals)[,1]
  # new column name
  newcolname <- paste0(var2clean,"_clean")
  # outlier variables to NA
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      !!newcolname := if_else(
        abs(residuals_z)>2 | is.na(residuals_z),
        NA,
        .data[[var2clean]])
    )
  # remove outlier rows
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(newcolname)))
  return(df)
}

## --- rename only the non-merge columns ---
rename_data_cols <- function(df, suffix) {
  data_cols <- setdiff(names(df), merge_cols)
  names(df)[names(df) %in% data_cols] <- paste0(data_cols, "_", suffix)
  df
}

## --- extract ROI name from column name ---
roi_from_name <- function(x) {
  str_extract(x,"(?<=sipfc\\.)[^_]+")
}

## --- extract Metabolite from column name ---
metabolite_from_name <- function(x) {
  str_extract(x,"(?<=_)[^_]+(?=(_|$))")
}

## --- predict model estimated means ---
model_prediction <- function(model, predictVar, 
                             groupVar = NULL, 
                             facetVar = NULL, 
                             panelVar = NULL,
                             cleandf) {
  # set main grid of predictor variables
  predict_grid <- seq(min(cleandf[[predictVar]], na.rm = TRUE),
                      max(cleandf[[predictVar]], na.rm = TRUE),
                      length.out = 100)
  
  # start building the "at" list and the right hand side (rhs)
  # terms with just predictVar
  at_list   <- setNames(list(predict_grid), predictVar)
  rhs_terms <- predictVar   # terms that go with "*" (varied together)
  cond_terms <- character(0) # terms that go with "|" (conditioning/faceting)
  
  # function to get levels for a categorical/faceting variable
  get_levels <- function(varname) {
    levels(as.factor(cleandf[[varname]]))
  }
  
  # function to get levels for a moderator (group) variable, 
  # numeric -> mean +/- sd
  get_group_levels <- function(varname) {
    mod_col <- cleandf[[varname]]
    if (is.factor(mod_col) || is.character(mod_col)) {
      levels(as.factor(mod_col))
    } else {
      m <- mean(mod_col, na.rm = TRUE)
      s <- sd(mod_col,   na.rm = TRUE)
      c(m - s, m, m + s)
    }
  }
  
  # groupVar: varied alongside predictVar (interaction term)
  if (!is.null(groupVar)) {
    at_list[[groupVar]] <- get_group_levels(groupVar)
    rhs_terms <- c(rhs_terms, groupVar)
  }
  
  # facetVar: conditioning variable
  if (!is.null(facetVar)) {
    at_list[[facetVar]] <- get_levels(facetVar)
    cond_terms <- c(cond_terms, facetVar)
  }
  
  # panelVar: another conditioning variable
  if (!is.null(panelVar)) {
    at_list[[panelVar]] <- get_levels(panelVar)
    cond_terms <- c(cond_terms, panelVar)
  }
  
  # build formula: predictVar (* groupVar) (| facetVar | panelVar)
  rhs <- paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " * ")
  if (length(cond_terms) > 0) {
    rhs <- paste(rhs, paste(cond_terms, collapse = " | "), sep = " | ")
  }
  fmla <- as.formula(paste("~", rhs))
  
  emm    <- emmeans(model, fmla, at = at_list)
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
  
  return(emm_df)
}

# compile results into one large data frame
compile_coefs <- function(files){
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(names(files), function(nm){
      df <- files[[nm]]$coefs
      df$term <- rownames(df)
      df$model <- nm
      rownames(df) <- NULL
      df
    })
  )
}
```

# Figure settings
```{r figure settings, include=FALSE}
# overall theme
paper_theme <- theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    axis.text = element_text(size=6),
    axis.title = element_text(size=7),
    plot.title = element_text(size=7),
    plot.margin = margin(0.5, 1, 0.5, 1, unit='mm'),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                   color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                    color=NA),
    plot.tag = element_text(size=6,face='bold'),
    legend.position = 'none',
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent',
                                    color=NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6)
  )

# plot_annotation theme
annot_theme <- theme(plot.background = element_rect(color=NA,fill='transparent'),
                     panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                    color=NA),
                     strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent',
                                    color=NA))

  alpha_marker = 0.25,
```

# Age distribution
```{r}
# load in data
main_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/broadband_sponevo_frow_20260508.csv')
main_df <- main_df %>%
  mutate(
    eeg_age_viable = ifelse(Viable==1,
                            eeg_age,
                            NA)
  )
main_df <- main_df %>% filter(!is.na(eeg_date))
main_df <- main_df %>% filter(!is.na(Viable))

# --- Histogram ---
age_hist <- ggplot(data = main_df)+
  geom_histogram(aes(x=eeg_age), binwidth = 2,
                 alpha=0.25, color = 'black',fill = 'black') +
  geom_histogram(aes(x=eeg_age_viable),binwidth = 2,
                 alpha = 0.25, color = "#AD3DCC", fill = "#AD3DCC" )+
  scale_x_continuous(expand= c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Age (yrs)") + ylab("Count")+
  paper_theme

# --- Waterfall plot ---
# After exclusion 
d <- data.frame(age = main_df$eeg_age_viable, id=main_df$lunaid, Sex = as.factor(main_df$sex))
p <- waterfall_plot(d,color=Sex)
waterfall_df <- p@data
eeg_waterfall_viable <- ggplot(data = waterfall_df, aes(x=age, y = age_id, color = Sex))+
  geom_point(shape = markers_list$marker_shape, size = markers_list$marker_size)+
  geom_line(aes(group=id), linewidth = lines_list$lunaid_size)+
  scale_color_manual(name = "",values = c("#3DA3CC","#CC663D"),
                                   labels = c("Female","Male")) + 
  paper_theme + xlab("Age (yrs)") + ylab("")

# Together
aligned_plts <- align_plots(
  plotlist = list(age_hist, eeg_waterfall_viable),
  axis = 'tb', align = 'h'
)
cowplot::plot_grid(aligned_plts[[1]],
                   aligned_plts[[2]],
                   nrow=1,
                   labels = c("A","B"),
                   label_size = 6)
ggsave(file.path(savedir,"age_dist.png"),
       dpi = 600, height = 50, width = 100, units = 'mm', bg = 'transparent')
```

## Age + Sex
```{r behavior plots, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# find rds file with results
filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "_Age_Effects.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

files <- lapply(filepaths, readRDS)

names(files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filepaths))

# compile all results into one data frame
behav_coefs <- compile_coefs(files)
# adjust p-values
behav_coefs <- behav_coefs %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = 'fdr')
  ) %>% ungroup()

behavior_plot <- function(modellist,colorslist,
                           markerslist, alphalist,
                           lineslist, figtheme,
                           labelslist){
  predict_df <- model_prediction(model = modellist$model,
                                 predictVar = "invage",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  predict_df$eeg_age <- 1/predict_df$invage
  modellist$cleandata$eeg_age <- 1/modellist$cleandata$invage
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    geom_point(data = modellist$cleandata,
               aes(x=eeg_age, y=behav),
               shape = markerslist$marker_shape,
               color = colorslist$behavior,
               alpha = alphalist$alpha_marker,
               size = markerslist$marker_size) + 
    geom_line(data = modellist$cleandata,
              aes(x = eeg_age, y=behav,
                  group = lunaid_clean),
              linewidth = lineslist$lunaid_size,
              color = colorslist$behavior,
              alpha = alphalist$alpha_lunaid)+
    geom_line(data= predict_df,
              aes(x=eeg_age, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist$behavior,
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size
              )+
    geom_ribbon(data = predict_df,
                aes(x=eeg_age, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                fill = colorslist$behavior,
                alpha = alphalist$alpha_ribbon,
                color=NA)+
    xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    figtheme
  return(plt)
}
```

# Spon/Evo figures
## Age * Condition * Sex
```{r}
# find rds file with results
filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "frow_AgeSexCondition_Effects.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

files <- lapply(filepaths, readRDS)

names(files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filepaths))

# compile all results into one data frame
sponevo_ageconditionsex_frow_coefs <- compile_coefs(files)
# adjust p-values
sponevo_ageconditionsex_frow_coefs <- sponevo_ageconditionsex_frow_coefs %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = 'fdr')
  ) %>% ungroup()

sponevo_agecondition_plot <- function(modellist,colorslist,
                                      powertype, row,
                                      markerslist, alphalist,
                                      lineslist, figtheme,
                                      labelslist){
  LABELS <- c("ASpower"="AS",
              "VGSpower"="VGS")
  VALUES <- c("ASpower"=colorslist[[powertype]],
              "VGSpower" = colorslist$vgs)
  
  if (row == "prow"){
    LINETYPE <- 'dashed'
  } else if (row == "frow"){
    LINETYPE <- "solid"
  }
  
  ### --- Age * Condition Figure for main paper ---
  predict_df <- model_prediction(model = modellist$model,
                                 groupVar = "condition",
                                 predictVar = "invage",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  predict_df$eeg_age <- 1/predict_df$invage
  modellist$cleandata$eeg_age <- 1/modellist$cleandata$invage
  
  agecond_plt <- ggplot() + 
    geom_point(data = modellist$cleandata,
               aes(x=eeg_age, y=power, color = condition),
               shape = markerslist$marker_shape,
               alpha = alphalist$alpha_marker,
               size = markerslist$marker_size) + 
    geom_line(data = modellist$cleandata,
              aes(x = eeg_age, y=power, color = condition,
                  group = interaction(lunaid_clean,condition)),
              linewidth = lineslist$lunaid_size,
              alpha = alphalist$alpha_lunaid)+
    geom_line(data= predict_df,
              aes(x=eeg_age, y=emmean, color = condition),
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size
              )+
    scale_color_manual(name = "Condition", values = VALUES,
                       labels = LABELS)+
    xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    figtheme
  
  ### --- Age * Condition * Sex for supplement ---
  predict_df <- model_prediction(model = modellist$model,
                                 groupVar = "condition",
                                 predictVar = "invage",
                                 facetVar = "sex",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  predict_df$eeg_age <- 1/predict_df$invage
  modellist$cleandata$eeg_age <- 1/modellist$cleandata$invage
  
  agecondsex_plt <- ggplot() + 
    geom_point(data = modellist$cleandata,
               aes(x=eeg_age, y=power, color = condition),
               shape = markerslist$marker_shape,
               alpha = alphalist$alpha_marker,
               size = markerslist$marker_size) + 
    geom_line(data = modellist$cleandata,
              aes(x = eeg_age, y=power, color = condition,
                  group = interaction(lunaid_clean,condition)),
              linewidth = lineslist$lunaid_size,
              alpha = alphalist$alpha_lunaid)+
    geom_line(data= predict_df,
              aes(x=eeg_age, y=emmean, color = condition),
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size
              )+
    scale_color_manual(name = "Condition", values = VALUES,
                       labels = LABELS)+
    facet_wrap(~sex, labeller = labeller(
      sex = c("F"="Females","M"="Males")))+
    xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    figtheme
  
  return(list(agecond = agecond_plt, agecondsex = agecondsex_plt))
}
```

### Difference plots
```{r}
# find rds file with results
filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "_AgeSexCondition_Effects.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

files <- lapply(filepaths, readRDS)

names(files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filepaths))

sponevo_diff_agecondition_plot <- function(modellist,
                                           powertype, row,
                                           markerslist, alphalist,
                                           colorslist,
                                           lineslist, figtheme,
                                           labelslist){
  # manual prediction
  invage_grid <- seq(min(modellist$cleandata$invage, na.rm = TRUE),
                     max(modellist$cleandata$invage, na.rm = TRUE),
                     length.out = 100)
  emm <- emmeans(modellist$model, ~ condition | invage, 
                 at = list(invage = invage_grid))
  if (powertype == "spon"){
  contrast_df <- contrast(emm, method = 'pairwise') %>% 
    confint() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      eeg_age = 1 / invage
    ) %>%
    arrange(eeg_age) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_age = ifelse(lower.CL > 0 & upper.CL < 0,
                       0, ifelse(
                         lower.CL < 0 & upper.CL > 0,
                         0,1)
                       ),
      y_sig = ifelse(sig_age == 1, estimate, NA), 
      lower.CL_sig = ifelse(sig_age == 1, lower.CL, NA),
      upper.CL_sig = ifelse(sig_age == 1, upper.CL, NA)
    )
  } else if (powertype == "evo"){
    contrast_df <- contrast(emm, method = 'pairwise') %>% 
      confint() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(
        eeg_age = 1 / invage
        ) %>%
      arrange(eeg_age) %>%
      mutate(
        sig_age = ifelse(lower.CL > 0 & upper.CL < 0,
                         0, ifelse(
                           lower.CL < 0 & upper.CL > 0,
                           0,1)
                         ),
        y_sig = ifelse(sig_age == 0, estimate, NA), 
        lower.CL_sig = ifelse(sig_age == 0, lower.CL, NA),
        upper.CL_sig = ifelse(sig_age == 0, upper.CL, NA)
      )
    }
  
  plt <- ggplot(data = contrast_df, aes(x=eeg_age)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed',
               color = 'black', linewidth = 0.3)+
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                fill = colorslist$vgs, alpha = 0.2, color = NA) + 
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL_sig, ymax = upper.CL_sig),
                fill = colorslist[[powertype]], alpha = 0.3, color = NA) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = estimate), 
              color = colorslist$vgs, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.3)+
    geom_line(aes(y= y_sig), 
              color = colorslist[[powertype]], linewidth = lineslist$line_size, 
              alpha = 1) + 
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3)+scale_y_continuous(n.breaks=3)+
    figtheme + xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel) +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size=5),
          axis.text = element_text(size=4),
          plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0,unit='mm'))
  return(plt)
}
```

```{r}
# find rds file with results
filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir,

# adjust p-values
sponevo_ageconditionsexrow_coefs <- sponevo_ageconditionsexrow_coefs %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = 'fdr')
  ) %>% ungroup()

# model results in a table for supplement
# spontaneous
spon_table <- tidy(files$spon_AgeConditionRowSex_Effects$model, 
                   effects = 'fixed', conf.int = TRUE)
spon_table_clean <- spon_table %>%
  select(term, estimate, statistic, df, p.value, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) %>%
  rename(Term = term, Beta = estimate, `t-value` = statistic, 
         `p-value` = p.value, `CI lower` = conf.low, `CI upper` = conf.high)
write.csv(spon_table_clean, file.path(savedir,"tables/spon_4way_table.csv"),row.names = FALSE)

# evoked
evo_table <- tidy(files$evo_AgeConditionRowSex_Effects$model, 
                   effects = 'fixed', conf.int = TRUE)
evo_table_clean <- evo_table %>%
  select(term, estimate, statistic, df, p.value, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3))) %>%
  rename(Term = term, Beta = estimate, `t-value` = statistic, 
         `p-value` = p.value, `CI lower` = conf.low, `CI upper` = conf.high)
write.csv(evo_table_clean, file.path(savedir,"tables/evo_4way_table.csv"),row.names = FALSE)


sponevo_ageconditionsexrow_effect_plot <- function(modellist,
                                                   colorslist,
                                                   powertype,
                                                   markerslist,
                                                   alphalist,
                                    lineslist, figtheme,
                                    labelslist){
  # figure colors
  if(powertype == "spon"){
    VALUES <- c("AS" = colorslist$spon,
                "VGS" = colorslist$vgs)
  } else if (powertype == "evo"){
    VALUES <- c("AS" = colorslist$evo,
                "VGS" = colorslist$vgs)
  }

  # predict model
  predict_df <- model_prediction(model = modellist$model,
                                 groupVar = "condition",
                                 facetVar = "sex",
                                 panelVar = "row",
                                 predictVar = "invage",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  predict_df$eeg_age <- 1/predict_df$invage
  modellist$cleandata$eeg_age <- 1/modellist$cleandata$invage
  
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    geom_line(data = predict_df, 
              aes(x=eeg_age, y=emmean,
                  color = condition,
                  linetype = row),
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    scale_color_manual(name = "Condition",
                       values = VALUES)+
    facet_wrap(~sex, labeller = labeller(sex = c("F" = "Females",
                                                 "M" = "Males")))+
    xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel) +
    figtheme
  return(plt)
}
spon_agecondrowsex <-
  sponevo_ageconditionsexrow_effect_plot(modellist = files$spon_AgeConditionRowSex_Effects,
                                       powertype = "spon",
                                       colorslist = colors_list,

                                       markerslist = markers_list,
                                       lineslist = lines_list,
                                       figtheme = paper_theme,
                                       labelslist = list(
                                         xlabel = c("Age (yrs)"),
                                         ylabel = 
                                         c("Spontaneous power (dB)")))

                                       powertype = "evo",

                                       lineslist = lines_list,

                                         xlabel = c("Age (yrs)"),
```

```{r spon/evo behavior plots, echo = FALSE}
# find rds file with results
filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "_(corAS|VGS)(evo|spon)Power(f|p)row_Effects.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

files <- lapply(filepaths, readRDS)

names(files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filepaths))

# compile all results into one data frame
sponevo_behav_coefs <- compile_coefs(files)

# add behavior column
sponevo_behav_coefs$behav <- sub("_.*","",sponevo_behav_coefs$model)
sponevo_behav_coefs$behav <- as.factor(sponevo_behav_coefs$behav)
# add row column
sponevo_behav_coefs$row <- sub(".*([fp]row)_.*","\\1",sponevo_behav_coefs$model)
sponevo_behav_coefs$row <- as.factor(sponevo_behav_coefs$row)

# adjust p-values
sponevo_behav_coefs <- sponevo_behav_coefs %>%
  group_by(term,behav, row) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = 'fdr')
  ) %>% ungroup()

sponevo_behav_plot <- function(modellist,colorslist,
                               task,powertype,
                               row,
                               markerslist, alphalist,
                               lineslist, figtheme,
                               labelslist){
  
  if (row == "prow"){
    LINETYPE <- 'dashed'
  } else if (row == "frow"){
    LINETYPE <- 'solid'
  }
  
  # predict responses
  predict_df <- model_prediction(modellist$model,
                                 predictVar = "power",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    geom_point(data = modellist$cleandata,
               aes(x=power,y=behav),
               color = colorslist[[powertype]],
               alpha = alphalist$alpha_marker, 
               shape = markerslist$marker_shape,
               size = markerslist$marker_size) + 
    geom_line( data = modellist$cleandata,
               aes(x = power, y=behav, group = lunaid_clean),
               color = colorslist[[powertype]],
               alpha = alphalist$alpha_marker,
               linewidth = lineslist$lunaid_size
               ) +
    geom_line(data = predict_df, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist[[powertype]],
              linetype = LINETYPE,
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    geom_ribbon(data = predict_df,
                aes(x = power, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                fill = colorslist[[powertype]],
                color = NA, alpha = alphalist$alpha_ribbon)+
    figtheme + xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel)
  return(plt)
}
```

```{r}
# find rds file with results
AS_filepaths <- list.files(

# find rds file with results
VGS_filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "_VGS(evo|spon)Power(f|p)row_Effects.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

VGS_files <- lapply(VGS_filepaths, readRDS)

names(VGS_files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(VGS_filepaths))

sponevo_behav_combined_plot <- function(ASmodellistfrow,
                                        ASmodellistprow,
                                        VGSmodellistfrow,
                                        VGSmodellistprow,
                                        colorslist, powertype,
                                        markerslist, alphalist,
                                        lineslist, figtheme,
                                        labelslist){
  if (powertype == "spon"){
    xlabel <- c("Spontaneous power (dB)")
  } else if (powertype == "evo"){
    xlabel <- c("Evoked power (dB)")
  }
  
  # predict responses
  ASpredict_df_frow <- model_prediction(ASmodellistfrow$model,
                                 predictVar = "power",
                                 cleandf = ASmodellistfrow$cleandata)
  VGSpredict_df_frow <- model_prediction(VGSmodellistfrow$model,
                                    predictVar = "power",
                                    cleandf = VGSmodellistfrow$cleandata)
  ASpredict_df_prow <- model_prediction(ASmodellistprow$model,
                                 predictVar = "power",
                                 cleandf = ASmodellistprow$cleandata)
  VGSpredict_df_prow <- model_prediction(VGSmodellistprow$model,
                                    predictVar = "power",
                                    cleandf = VGSmodellistprow$cleandata)
  
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    # VGS lines
    # p-row
    geom_line(data = VGSpredict_df_prow, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist$vgs,
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size,
              linetype = "dashed")+
    # f-row
    geom_line(data = VGSpredict_df_frow, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist$vgs,
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    # AS lines
    # p-row
    geom_line(data = ASpredict_df_prow, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist[[powertype]],
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size,
              linetype = "dashed")+
    # f-row
    geom_line(data = ASpredict_df_frow, 
              aes(x=power, y=emmean),
              color = colorslist[[powertype]],
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    figtheme + xlab(xlabel) + ylab(labelslist$ylabel)
  return(plt)
}
```

```{r}
# adjust margins
behav_margin <- margin(0.5,1,0.5,1, unit='mm')
age_margin <- margin(0.5,3,0.5,1, unit = 'mm')

### --- Age * Condition plot + AS f-row behavior plots ---
spon_plt <- spon_frow_agecondsex$agecond +
  theme(plot.margin = age_margin,
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

  theme(plot.margin = age_margin)
# remove axis titles and change margins from spontaneous plots

  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = behav_margin)
cvlat_spon <- cvlat_ASspon_frow + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = behav_margin)
avglat_spon <- avglat_ASspon_frow + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = behav_margin) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) round(x, 1))

  theme(plot.margin = behav_margin)
cvlat_evo <- cvlat_ASevo_frow + 
  theme(plot.margin = behav_margin)

  theme(plot.margin = behav_margin) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) round(x, 1))

  plotlist = list(spon_plt,

)

       dpi = 600, units = 'mm', width = 170, height = 90,
```

```{r, echo = F}
enhancedt_interaction_df$freq <- freqs[enhancedt_interaction_df$freq_idx]
# age
```

## Behavior
### F-row
```{r, echo = FALSE}
# find rds file with results
AS_filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "corASfrowERSPclusters_Effect.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

AS_files <- lapply(AS_filepaths, readRDS)

names(AS_files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(AS_filepaths))

# VGS interaction resutlts
VGS_filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "frowinteraction.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)

VGS_files <- lapply(VGS_filepaths, readRDS)

names(VGS_files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(VGS_filepaths))

cluster_behav_plot <- function(AS_modellist, 
                               VGS_modellist,
                               cluster,behav, colorslist,
                               markerslist, alphalist,
                               lineslist, figtheme,
                               labelslist,
                               share_yaxis = NULL){
  
  # --- Violin plot of ERSP distribution ---
  AS_df <- AS_modellist$cleandata
  AS_df <- AS_df %>% mutate(
    condition = as.factor("AS"))
  AS_df <- AS_df[,c("behav","invage","sex",cluster,
                    "lunaid_clean","condition")]
  colnames(AS_df) <-  c("behav","invage","sex","ersp",
                        "lunaid_clean","condition")
  VGS_df <- VGS_modellist$cleandata 
  VGS_df <- VGS_df %>% mutate(
    condition = as.factor("VGS"))
  VGS_df <- VGS_df[,c(behav,"invage",paste0("VGS_",cluster,
                                            "_ersp_interaction_frow"),
                      "sex",
                      "lunaid_clean","condition")]
  VGS_df <- VGS_df[, c(behav, "invage","sex",
                       paste0("VGS_",cluster,"_ersp_interaction_frow"),
                       "lunaid_clean","condition")]
  colnames(VGS_df) <- c("behav","invage","sex","ersp",
                        "lunaid_clean","condition")
  long_df <- rbind(AS_df, VGS_df)
  
  violin_plt <- ggplot(data=long_df, 
                       aes(x=condition,y=ersp,color= condition))+
    geom_jitter(alpha = 0.75, size = 0.2, 
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.25,
                                                dodge.width = 0.75),
                shape = 16) + 
     stat_slab(aes(fill = condition), 
                  adjust = 0.75,
                  width = 0.6,
                  justification = -0.25,
                  color = NA,
                  alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA,
                     width = 0.15, 
                     color='black',
                     fill = NA,
                     size=0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, 
                      values = c("AS" = colorslist[[cluster]],
                                              "VGS" = colorslist$vgs)) + 
    scale_color_manual(name = NULL, 
                       values = c("AS" = colorslist[[cluster]],
                                              "VGS" = colorslist$vgs)) +
    figtheme +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
    ylab("ERSP (dB)")
  
  # --- Age trajectory plot ---
  long_df$eeg_age <- 1/long_df$invage
  trajectory_plt <- ggplot(data = long_df, 
                           aes(x=eeg_age, y=ersp, color = condition)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = 0.3)+
    geom_smooth(method='lm',formula = y~I(1/x),
                linewidth = lineslist$line_size,se=F)+
    scale_color_manual(name=NULL, 
                       values = c("AS" = colorslist[[cluster]],
                                  "VGS" = colorslist$vgs))+
    figtheme + xlab(labelslist$xlabel) + ylab("ERSP (dB)")

  # --- Behavior plots ---
  # AS model predictions
  AS_predict_df <- model_prediction(model = AS_modellist$model,
                                    predictVar = cluster,
                                    cleandf = AS_modellist$cleandata)
  colnames(AS_predict_df) <- c("ersp","emmean","SE","df",
                               "lower.CL","upper.CL")
  # VGS model predictions
  VGS_predict_df <- model_prediction(model = VGS_modellist$model,
                                     predictVar = paste0("VGS_",
                                                         cluster,
                                                         "_ersp_interaction_frow"),
                                     groupVar = "invage",
                                     cleandf = VGS_modellist$cleandata)
  colnames(VGS_predict_df) <- c("ersp","invage","emmean","SE","df",
                                "lower.CL","upper.CL")
  VGS_predict_df$eeg_age <- as.factor(round(1/VGS_predict_df$invage))
  
  # determine if axes should be shared
  if (!is.null(share_yaxis)){
    if (share_yaxis == 1){
      # figure out a shared range across both predictions first
      y_min <- min(c(AS_predict_df$lower.CL, VGS_predict_df$lower.CL))
      y_max <- max(c(AS_predict_df$upper.CL, VGS_predict_df$upper.CL))
      shared_breaks <- scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5)(c(y_min, y_max))
      yaxis <- scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), breaks = shared_breaks)
      } 
    } else {
    yaxis <- scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) round(x,2))
  }
  
  # --- AS ---
  AS_behav_plt <- ggplot()+
    geom_line(data = AS_predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, y=emmean),color = colorslist[[cluster]])+
    geom_ribbon(data = AS_predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, ymin= lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
              fill = colorslist[[cluster]],
              color=NA, alpha = 0.3)+ ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    yaxis +
    xlab("AS ERSP (dB)")+
    figtheme 

  # --- VGS ---
  VGS_behav_plt <- ggplot()+
    geom_line(data = VGS_predict_df, 
              aes(x = ersp, y = emmean, color = eeg_age),
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size) + 
    geom_ribbon(data = VGS_predict_df,
              aes(x = ersp, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, 
                  fill = eeg_age),
              alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                       values = c("grey20","grey50","grey80"))+
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                      values = c("grey20","grey50","grey80"))+
    ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    xlab("VGS ERSP (dB)")+
    yaxis +
    figtheme
  
  
  
  return(list(dist_plt = violin_plt, traj_plt = trajectory_plt, 
              AS_plt = AS_behav_plt, 
              VGS_plt = VGS_behav_plt))
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
cluster_behav_plot <- function(AS_modellist, 
                               VGS_modellist,
                               cluster,behav, colorslist,
                               markerslist, alphalist,
                               lineslist, figtheme,
                               labelslist){
  # violin plot of ERSP distribution
  AS_df <- AS_modellist$cleandata
  AS_df <- AS_df %>% mutate(
    condition = as.factor("AS"))
  AS_df <- AS_df[,c("behav","invage","sex",cluster,"lunaid_clean","condition")]
  colnames(AS_df) <-  c("behav","invage","sex","ersp","lunaid_clean","condition")
  VGS_df <- VGS_modellist$cleandata 
  VGS_df <- VGS_df %>% mutate(
    condition = as.factor("VGS"))
  VGS_df <- VGS_df[,c(behav,"invage",paste0("VGS_",cluster,"_ersp_interaction_prow"),"sex","lunaid_clean","condition")]
  VGS_df <- VGS_df[, c(behav, "invage","sex",paste0("VGS_",cluster,"_ersp_interaction_prow"),"lunaid_clean","condition")]
  colnames(VGS_df) <- c("behav","invage","sex","ersp","lunaid_clean","condition")
  long_df <- rbind(AS_df, VGS_df)
  
  violin_plt <- ggplot(data=long_df, 
                       aes(x=condition,y=ersp,color= condition))+
    geom_jitter(alpha = 0.75, size = 0.2, 
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.25,
                                                dodge.width = 0.75),
                shape = 16) + 
     stat_slab(aes(fill = condition), 
                  adjust = 0.75,
                  width = 0.6,
                  justification = -0.25,
                  color = NA,
                  alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA,
                     width = 0.15, 
                     color='black',
                     fill = NA,
                     size=0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = c("AS" = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]],
                                              "VGS" = colorslist$vgsprow)) + 
    scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = c("AS" = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]],
                                              "VGS" = colorslist$vgsprow)) +
    figtheme + ylab("ERSP (dB)")+
    theme(legend.position = 'none',
          axis.title.x = element_blank())
  # return(violin_plt)
  
  long_df$eeg_age <- 1/long_df$invage
  trajectory_plt <- ggplot(data = long_df, aes(x=eeg_age, y=ersp, color = condition)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = 0.3)+
    geom_smooth(method='lm',formula = y~I(1/x),
                linewidth = lineslist$line_size,se=F)+
    scale_color_manual(name=NULL, 
                       values = c("AS" = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]],
                                  "VGS" = colorslist$vgsprow))+
    figtheme + xlab(labelslist$xlabel)+ ylab("ERSP (dB)")
    theme(legend.position = 'none'
          # axis.title.y = element_blank()
          )
  # return(trajectory_plt)
  
  # behavior plot
  # AS model predictions
  AS_predict_df <- model_prediction(model = AS_modellist$model,
                                    predictVar = cluster,
                                    cleandf = AS_modellist$cleandata)
  colnames(AS_predict_df) <- c("ersp","emmean","SE","df","lower.CL","upper.CL")
  
  # just AS
  AS_behav_plt <- ggplot()+
    geom_line(data = AS_predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, y=emmean),color = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]])+
    geom_ribbon(data = AS_predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, ymin= lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
              fill = colorslist[[paste0(cluster,"prow")]],
              color=NA, alpha = 0.3)+ ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+
    figtheme + xlab("AS ERSP (dB)")
  
  return(list(dist_plt = violin_plt, traj_plt = trajectory_plt, 
         AS_plt = AS_behav_plt))
}
```

# Spon/Evo ~ Age*ERSP
## F-row
```{r, echo =FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', message=FALSE}
# find rds file with results
filepaths <- list.files(
  path = resultsdir, 
  pattern = "_cluster\\d+ERSPfrow_Effect.rds$", 
  full.names = TRUE,                    
  recursive = FALSE,                     
  ignore.case = TRUE                    
)
files <- lapply(filepaths, readRDS)
names(files)  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filepaths))

# compile all results into one data frame
sponevo_ersp_frow_coefs <- compile_coefs(files)

# condition column
sponevo_ersp_frow_coefs$condition <- sub(".*(corAS|VGS).*","\\1", sponevo_ersp_frow_coefs$model)

# adjust p-values
sponevo_ersp_frow_coefs <- sponevo_ersp_frow_coefs %>%
  group_by(term, condition) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = 'fdr')
  ) %>% ungroup()

sponevo_ersp_interaction_plot <- function(modellist,colorslist,
                                    task,powertype,
                                    cluster,
                                    markerslist, alphalist,
                                    lineslist, figtheme,
                                    labelslist){
  if (powertype == "spon"){
    COLOR_interaction <- c("#231631","#67428F","#A585C7")
  } else if (powertype == "evo"){
    COLOR_interaction <- c("#132E34","#388599","#88C4D3")
  }
  
  # predict responses
  predict_df <- model_prediction(model = modellist$model,
                                 predictVar = "ersp",
                                 groupVar = "invage",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  predict_df$eeg_age <- as.factor(round(1/predict_df$invage))
  
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    geom_line(data = predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, y=emmean, color = eeg_age),
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    geom_ribbon(data = predict_df, 
                aes(x=ersp, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL,
                    fill = eeg_age),
                color=NA, alpha = alphalist$alpha_ribbon)+
    scale_color_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                       values = COLOR_interaction)+
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                      values = COLOR_interaction)+
    ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+xlab(labelslist$xlabel)+
    figtheme
  # print(plt)
  
  # Johnson-Neyman plot
  recip_trans <- scales::trans_new(
    name      = "recip",
    transform = function(x) 1/x,
    inverse   = function(x) 1/x
    )
  jn_out  <- johnson_neyman(modellist$model,
                            pred        = ersp,
                            modx        = invage,
                            insig.color = "grey50",
                            sig.color   = colorslist[[cluster]],
                            line.thickness = 0.6)
  jn_out$plot@layers$geom_segment <- NULL
  jn_plt <- jn_out$plot + 
    scale_x_continuous(name   = "Age (yrs)",
                       trans  = recip_trans,
                       labels = c(10, 20, 30),
                       breaks = c(1/10, 1/20, 1/30),
                       limits = c(min(modellist$cleandata$invage),
                                  max(modellist$cleandata$invage))) +
    ylab(labelslist$jnlabel) +
    figtheme +
    theme(legend.position = 'none',
          plot.title = element_blank())
  # print(jn_plt)
  
  return(list(main_plot = plt, jn_plot = jn_plt, jn_bounds = jn_out$bounds))
}
```

```{r, echo =FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', message=FALSE}
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = 'fdr')
  ) %>% ungroup()

sponevo_ersp_interaction_plot <- function(modellist,colorslist,
                                    task,powertype,
                                    cluster,
                                    markerslist, alphalist,
                                    lineslist, figtheme,
                                    labelslist){
  if (powertype == "spon"){
    COLOR_interaction <- c("#231631","#67428F","#A585C7")
  } else if (powertype == "evo"){
    COLOR_interaction <- c("#132E34","#388599","#88C4D3")
  }
  
  # predict responses
  predict_df <- model_prediction(model = modellist$model,
                                 predictVar = "ersp",
                                 groupVar = "invage",
                                 cleandf = modellist$cleandata)
  predict_df$eeg_age <- as.factor(round(1/predict_df$invage))
  
  plt <- ggplot() + 
    # geom_point(data = modellist$cleandata, 
    #            aes(x=ersp,y=power),
    #            alpha = alphalist$alpha_marker,
    #            shape = markerslist$marker_shape,
    #            size = markerslist$marker_size,
    #            color = colorslist[[powertype]])+
    # geom_line(data = modellist$cleandata,
    #           aes(x=ersp, y=power,
    #               group = lunaid_clean),
    #           alpha = alphalist$alpha_lunaid,
    #           linewidth = lineslist$lunaid_size,
    #           color = colorslist[[powertype]])+
    geom_line(data = predict_df, 
              aes(x=ersp, y=emmean, color = eeg_age),
              linewidth = lineslist$line_size)+
    geom_ribbon(data = predict_df, 
                aes(x=ersp, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL,
                    fill = eeg_age),
                color=NA, alpha = alphalist$alpha_ribbon)+
    scale_color_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                       values = COLOR_interaction)+
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Age (yrs)",
                      values = COLOR_interaction)+
    ylab(labelslist$ylabel)+xlab(labelslist$xlabel)+
    figtheme
  # print(plt)
  
  # Johnson-Neyman plot
  recip_trans <- scales::trans_new(
    name      = "recip",
    transform = function(x) 1/x,
    inverse   = function(x) 1/x
    )
  jn_out  <- johnson_neyman(modellist$model,
                            pred        = ersp,
                            modx        = invage,
                            insig.color = "grey50",
                            sig.color   = colorslist[[cluster]],
                            line.thickness = 0.6)
  jn_out$plot@layers$geom_segment <- NULL
  jn_plt <- jn_out$plot + 
    scale_x_continuous(name   = "Age (yrs)",
                       trans  = recip_trans,
                       labels = c(10, 20, 30),
                       breaks = c(1/10, 1/20, 1/30),
                       limits = c(min(modellist$cleandata$invage),
                                  max(modellist$cleandata$invage))) +
    ylab("Slope of ERSP on power") +
    figtheme +
    theme(legend.position = 'none',
          plot.title = element_blank())
  # print(jn_plt)
  
  return(list(main_plot = plt, jn_plot = jn_plt, jn_bounds = jn_out$bounds))
}
```

```{r}
corAS.ids_list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/corAS_data/prep/corAS_prep_avgtrl_ids.mat")
VGS.ids_list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/VGS_data/prep/VGS_prep_avgtrl_ids.mat")

VGSersp.list <- readMat("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/ERSPdata/VGS_data/prep/VGS_prep_avgtrl_frow_ersp.mat")

# unlist variables
times <- as.numeric(corASersp.list[["times"]])
freqs <- as.numeric(corASersp.list[["freqs"]])
corASersp_all <- corASersp.list[["avg.ersp"]]
VGSersp <- VGSersp.list[["avg.ersp"]]
corASids <- corAS.ids_list[["idmat"]]

# remove non-viable from AS ersp
viable_idx <- corASids[,4] == 1
corASersp <- corASersp_all[viable_idx, , ]

# average across people
avgcorASersp <- apply(corASersp, c(2,3), mean, na.rm=T)
avgVGSersp <- apply(VGSersp, c(2,3), mean, na.rm=T)

# convert to data frames for plotting
corASersp_df <- melt(avgcorASersp)
colnames(corASersp_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
corASersp_df$time <- times[corASersp_df$time_idx]
corASersp_df$freq <- freqs[corASersp_df$freq_idx]

VGSersp_df <- melt(avgVGSersp)
colnames(VGSersp_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
VGSersp_df$time <- times[VGSersp_df$time_idx]
VGSersp_df$freq <- freqs[VGSersp_df$freq_idx]

# compute tile sizes
time_res <- min(diff(sort(unique(corASersp_df$time))))
freq_res <- min(diff(sort(unique(corASersp_df$freq))))

# --- Raw ERSP ---
ASersp_plt <- ggplot(data = corASersp_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +

    legend.key.width = unit(5,'mm'),
```

```{r}
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  age_theme

condition_entval_plt <- ggplot(data = enhancedt_condition_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="Enhanced\nt-value",
                       limits = c(0,300)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,250,500), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,35,70),expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  condition_theme

interaction_entval_plt <- ggplot(data = enhancedt_interaction_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="Enhanced\nt-value",
                       limits = c(0,300)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,250,500), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,35,70),expand = c(0,0))+
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  interaction_theme

# save legend
entval_legend <- get_legend(interaction_entval_plt)
ggsave(file.path(savedir,"entval_legend.png"),entval_legend, width = 15, height = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')

age <- age_entval_plt + theme(legend.position = 'none',
                            axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  ggtitle("Inverse age")

condition <- condition_entval_plt  + theme(legend.position = 'none',
                            axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                            axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  ggtitle("Condition")

interaction <- interaction_entval_plt  + theme(legend.position = 'none',
                            axis.title = element_blank(),
                            axis.text.y = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Interaction")

aligned_plts <- align_plots(
  plotlist = list(age,condition,interaction),
  align = 'h', axis = 'tb'
)
plot_grid(aligned_plts[[1]],
          aligned_plts[[2]],
          aligned_plts[[3]],
          nrow=1, 
          rel_widths = c(1.3,1,1))
ggsave(file.path(savedir, "entval_frow_heatmap.png"), width = 65, height = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')
```

### Null distributions
```{r}
# --- Null distributions ---
age_null_thres <- quantile(null_age_df$value, c(0.99))
age_null_plt <- ggplot(data = null_age_df, aes(x=value))+
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = age_null_thres, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 'dashed',color='red')+
  xlab("Enhanced t-value")+
  ylab("Count")+
  age_theme

condition_null_thres <- quantile(null_condition_df$value, c(0.99))
condition_null_plt <- ggplot(data = null_condition_df, aes(x=value))+
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = condition_null_thres, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 'dashed',color='red')+
  xlab("Enhanced t-value")+
  ylab("Count")+
  condition_theme

interaction_null_thres <- quantile(null_interaction_df$value, c(0.99))
interaction_null_plt <- ggplot(data = null_interaction_df, aes(x=value))+
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = interaction_null_thres, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 'dashed',color='red')+
  xlab("Enhanced t-value")+
  ylab("Count")+
  interaction_theme

age <- age_null_plt + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Inverse Age")
condition <- condition_null_plt + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Condition")
interaction <- interaction_null_plt + theme(axis.title = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Interaction")
aligned_plts <- align_plots(plotlist = list(age, condition, interaction),
                            align = 'h', axis='tb')
plot_grid(aligned_plts[[1]],
          aligned_plts[[2]],
          aligned_plts[[3]],
          nrow=1,
          rel_widths = c(1.1,1,1))
ggsave(file.path(savedir, "null_dist.png"), width = 65, height = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')
```

### Single Participant
```{r}
# --- Single participant ERSP ---
sub_ersp <- corASersp[1, ,]
sub_ersp_df <- melt(sub_ersp)
colnames(sub_ersp_df) <- c("freq_idx","time_idx","value")
sub_ersp_df$time <- times[sub_ersp_df$time_idx]
sub_ersp_df$freq <- freqs[sub_ersp_df$freq_idx]

interaction_subersp_plt <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = sub_ersp_df, aes(x=time, y=freq, fill = value)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="ERSP (dB)",
                       limits = c(-3,6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,250,500), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3,35,70),expand = c(0,0))+
  new_scale_fill()+
  geom_raster(data = mask_interaction_df, aes(x=time,y=freq, fill = value),alpha=0.5)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1"=NA,
                               "0" = "black"))+
  guides(fill = 'none')+
  xlab("Preparatory time (ms)") + ylab("Frequency (dB)")+
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth=0.3),
    axis.text = element_text(size=5),
    axis.title = element_text(size=6),
    plot.title = element_text(size=6),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent',color = NULL),
    legend.key.height = unit(4,'mm'),
    legend.key.width = unit(5,'mm'),
    legend.title = element_text(size=7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1.75, 1.5, 1.5, unit='mm'),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                   color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent',
                                    color=NA),
    plot.tag = element_text(size=6,face='bold'),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent',
                                    color=NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6)
  )
interaction_subersp_plt

sub_ersp_legend <- get_legend(interaction_subersp_plt)
ggsave(file.path(savedir,"sub_ersp_legend.png"), sub_ersp_legend,
       width = 15, height = 30, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')

interaction_subersp_plt + theme(legend.position = 'none',axis.title = element_blank())
ggsave(file.path(savedir,"sub_maskersp.png"), width = 25, height = 20, units = 'mm',
       dpi = 600, bg = 'transparent')

```
